baselineProvenance: The unguarded PendingDialog onClose={leave} also exists in baseline 53cbc8efce854f8f067acef8372daf49be82f9c3. Discovered by this localization browser matrix; no claim that baseline itself was browser-reproduced.
method: Hold the lazy popup code so PendingDialog remains mounted. Open a real card, capture and hold the real native close event during Back without changing DOM closure/history, go Forward until the same dialog is open at the detail URL, then replay delivery on the same target. Record synchronous history.back calls. Each actual native-close scenario uses its own fresh context.
observedCause: PendingDialog onClose unconditionally calls leave. A close event from the preceding Back delivered after Forward reopening observes shown=true/leaving=false and synchronously issues an extra history.back, closing the new popup. The loaded DetailPopup already guards this case with !dialogRef.current?.open.
recommendedFix: Guard PendingDialog onClose with the current dialog open state, matching DetailPopup, and retain genuine native closure handling. Strengthen the existing held-code stand-in browser case with a deliberately delayed close delivery. Do not add sleep before Forward.
limits: Captured native event is replayed with a synthetic Event(close), so the controlled check demonstrates the state/event ordering defect. The original uninstrumented preview matrix separately observed the same reopen-then-close symptom. Baseline code was inspected but baseline artifact itself was not run.
implementedFix: PendingDialog onClose only calls leave when event.currentTarget.open is false, ignoring close delivery after Forward has already reopened the dialog.
parentValidation: Parent independently runs complete popup/popup-layout and French search suites in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit; this report records only the authorized six controlled Chromium cases.
